verdict.rationale: A data-use and privacy policy is a fair question for a GPU cloud provider, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no documented opt-out, no policy stating customer data is excluded from model training, and no related setting. Mentions of single-tenant infrastructure and firewalls are adjacent controls and do not count as a training-data opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
